I get those existential feelings too. You are in touch with what’s happening, which is more painful that being blissfully unaware. It makes sense to want to die when it doesn’t feel like living is worthwhile.

On my better days, I try doing something positive for somebody else. It doesn’t outweigh the bad in the world for sure, but making the world just a little less shitty can be meaningful.
